description: This file defines models and a fetcher for Seeking Alpha Forward EPS Estimates, including query parameters, data structures, and data fetching and transformation logic.

classes.name: SAForwardEpsEstimatesQueryParams
classes.description: Model for query parameters for Seeking Alpha Forward EPS Estimates, including validation for the symbol and period type.

classes.name: SAForwardEpsEstimatesData
classes.description: Data model for the EPS estimates, including actuals, estimates, and growth metrics.

classes.name: SAForwardEpsEstimatesFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class to retrieve and process EPS estimates data from Seeking Alpha API.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a SAForwardEpsEstimatesQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw EPS estimates data from Seeking Alpha API for given query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into a list of SAForwardEpsEstimatesData instances.
